summary: Cannabist Co Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the completion of the sale of substantially all Delaware assets to Arboretum DE PermitCo LLC for total consideration of $16.5 million, consisting of $14.025 million at closing (subject to working capital adjustments) and $2.475 million escrowed for twelve months. The company is in CCAA proceedings in Canada and has provisional Chapter 15 recognition in the U.S. The board determined post-closing it will be unable to continue SEC filings without unreasonable expense. Watch for the May 12 bankruptcy court hearing on final recognition and potential delisting.
